profile.headline: Frontend Web Developer at PrimeGov
profile.summary:
Front-end web developer with a background in film and experience as a Compliance Analyst.  After witnessing the vast opportunities for growth professionally and creatively at the technology firm I work at, I decided to pursue web development as a new career.  As a lover of foreign languages and story-telling, I compare web development to learning new languages and using those skills to create something meaningful. My goal is to expand my skills and join a synergistic team that requires creativity in making solutions that will better impact the world.  

I pursued a certification in Full-Stack Web Development from the University of Arizona to round out my skills in HTML, CSS & Javascript. I believe that these skills combined with my excellent communication and collaboration make me a valuable asset to any web development team.

positions.title: Compliance Analyst
positions.description:
Maintain compliance reports and information for an account of more than 650 resources and growing, by communicating constantly with multiple levels of management.

Promoted by manager within 5 months to current position of Compliance Analyst for attention to detail and professionality.

positions.title: Mission Leader
positions.description: Led a household of seven men of various ages, spoke to large audiences about faith on multiple occasions, participated in human and spiritual formation of college-aged men through small group discussion and one-on-one discipleship, and planned and led social and spiritual events on a weekly basis.

projects.title: Pokepedia
projects.description:
Fully deployed project can be viewed here: https://polar-peak-70360.herokuapp.com/

A full-stack web application optimized for mobile usage to be utilized with Pokemon Go. 
Application has three main facets: 1) Allows users to search the first 151 pokemon; 2) Allows a user to create their ideal pokemon teams as battling has now been implemented in Pokemon Go; and 3) A chat room where users can discuss various topics on the world of Pokemon. 

Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Javascript, Node.js, Express.js, Sequelize, Passport.js, MySQL

projects.title: Giphy App
projects.description:
An app that allows a user to click a button the top of the page that will generate 10 gifs related to the button. Gifs initially appear as still images but once clicked go into motion. A user also has the opportunity to add their own buttons via a submit form that will do the same. 

Link to repository: https://github.com/ajgasca/Giphy-App
